title: About Palm Beach Neurology | West Palm Beach Neurologists
desc: For 25+ years, Palm Beach Neurology has cared for the Palm Beaches with subspecialty neurologists and an on-site clinical research institute in West Palm Beach.
story_html:
For more than 25 years, Palm Beach Neurology & Premiere Research Institute has cared for families across the Palm Beaches. From our single West Palm Beach office, our physicians have built lasting relationships with patients navigating some of the most complex conditions in medicine — always guided by a simple belief: we are treating the patient, not just the disease.

A team of subspecialty neurologists

Neurology is a broad field, and no single physician can be an expert in all of it. That is why our practice brings together neurologists who each concentrate on specific areas — headache and migraine, epilepsy and seizures, Parkinson's and movement disorders, memory loss and Alzheimer's, multiple sclerosis, and neuromuscular disease. Whether you need an EEG, EMG and nerve-conduction testing, Botox for chronic migraine, or steady care for a lifelong condition, you are seen by a doctor who focuses on exactly what you are facing. You can meet our neurologists to learn more about their backgrounds.

Under the same roof, our on-site Premiere Research Institute conducts carefully monitored clinical trials in Alzheimer's, migraine, and multiple sclerosis — often at no cost to those who take part. This gives our patients access to emerging approaches while keeping our physicians at the leading edge of neurology. We also offer a free, no-cost Memory Screen, a short and reassuring visit of about 30 minutes for anyone with questions about memory or thinking.

We are proud to serve West Palm Beach and the surrounding communities, and we are always accepting new patients. If you have questions or would like to be seen, we would be glad to help — request an appointment or call our office at 561-845-0500.
mission: Our mission is to help every patient stay sharp and stay in control by treating the whole person, not just the diagnosis. We combine subspecialty neurology expertise with compassionate, plain-English care and on-site access to advancing research.

values.title: Treating the Patient, Not Just the Disease
values.desc: We look beyond the diagnosis to the person in front of us — listening carefully, explaining clearly, and building care around your goals and your life.

values.title: Subspecialty Expertise

values.title: Clear, Compassionate Communication
